entries.name: clearedForm_eq_headSubsetExpansion
entries.note: Exact Finset.powerset expansion of the cleared head score. Expand each product of A_h(x)+B_h(y) with Finset.prod_add, group by the A-side subset T, and separate numerator choices into headSubsetLeftDeriv and headSubsetRightDeriv. Parent assembly: exists_clearedForm_outerProduct_decomp first rewrites by this identity, then applies exists_headSubsetExpansion_outerProduct_decomp.

entries.name: exists_headSubsetExpansion_outerProduct_decomp
entries.note: Boundary merge/count for the P2.3 subset expansion. Use two tagged copies of powerset univ; omit the zero left term at T=empty, fold the right term at T=univ into the left term, and keep two terms for interior T. The empty-set right piece has constant left factor. Count with card_powerset and two_mul_two_pow_sub. Consumed by the sorry-free exists_clearedForm_outerProduct_decomp parent.

entries.name: signRank_le_of_multilinear_signRepr
entries.note: Factor eval(cubePoint(blockJoin x y)) P as a sum over left supports mu with |mu|<=d, then apply signRank_le_card_of_signRepr_sum and card_subsets_card_le. Multilinearity must be used to identify each monomial with its squarefree support; the empty support supplies the constant factor.

entries.name: exists_generalPosition_reposition
entries.note: Perturb the finite unit family inside its strict sign-margin neighborhood so every injective Fin r selection is linearly independent. The excluded dependent configurations form a finite union of measure-zero subsets of the product of spheres. Consumed by exists_isotropic_reposition.

entries.name: exists_isotropic_of_generalPosition
entries.note: Deepest analytic kernel. From general position and r<card, minimize the log quadratic-form potential over positive-definite determinant-one matrices; prove coercivity, obtain a minimizer, and derive the isotropy identity from the first-order condition. Consumed by exists_isotropic_reposition.
